harmonicFunction.title: Melodic Doubling
harmonicFunction.description: Playing the same melody on different strings or in different octaves creates richness and allows for smooth voice leading. Technique uses parallel melodies in unison for thicker, more present melodic lines.

harmonicFunction.title: Harmonic Reinforcement
harmonicFunction.description: Multiple instruments playing the same notes creates powerful reinforcement without adding harmonic complexity. Increases volume and presence in choir unisons and guitar/bass doubling.

historicalDevelopment.title: Guitar Techniques
historicalDevelopment.description: Octave doubling for fuller sound, string bending to reach unison pitches, harmonics creating natural unison overtones, slide techniques for smooth unison transitions, and different fingering positions for the same note.

historicalDevelopment.title: Ensemble and Production
historicalDevelopment.description: From choir sections and orchestral doubling to modern track layering, stereo doubling, and dynamic emphasis techniques, unison has been a foundational tool for harmonic clarity and mix density throughout music history.
